title: Profile Tags
summary: Tags are small colored name plaquettes players can earn and show off alongside their rank. They are purely cosmetic and separate from rank: a tag says something about what you did or contributed, not your rank/permission level. There are 19 tags total, split between a curated set of 16 always-available tags and 3 extra tags layered on top for Diamond Trophy milestones. A player can own several tags at once but only ever displays one at a time.
how_it_works: Every tag is defined network-wide (in NetworkCore) with a display name, a short description of how it's earned, a theme color, and a colored plaquette glyph. Owning a tag and equipping a tag are different things: a player can earn/hold many tags, but only one can be the 'active' tag at a time. The active tag is shown two places in-game: on the floating nameplate above the player's head (the bottom of its three lines, below the rank+level line) and in the player's tab-list/nick styling. Equipping a different owned tag simply swaps which one is shown; it does not remove ownership of the others. Most tags are permanent once earned and can never be lost. One tag (Booster) is 'dynamic': it is tied to actively boosting the ReimaginedCraft Discord server, and the design intent (per the tag's own definition) is that it stops being available once the boost lapses, unlike every other tag which is kept forever once granted.
how_to_access: Open your profile with /profile (or the compass-style profile item on the hub hotbar), then open the Tags page from the main profile screen. By default the Tags page only lists tags you already own; use the Search button to browse the full catalog, including tags you haven't earned yet (shown greyed out with a 'Not yet earned' note). Click any tag you own to equip it as your active tag, or click your currently-equipped tag again to unequip it (showing no tag at all). The Booster tag specifically is claimed from the profile's Discord page rather than the Tags page: link your Discord account, boost the ReimaginedCraft Discord server, then use the 'Redeem Tag' button that appears on the Discord page while you are boosting — this grants the tag and equips it immediately.

guis.title: Tags
guis.description: Sub-page of the player Profile menu listing every tag the player owns (or, while searching, every tag that exists) as a small colored name-tag icon.
guis.how_to_open: Open /profile, then click the Tags button on the main profile page.

slots.item: Owned tag plaquette, dyed to the tag's color
slots.action: Click to equip as your active tag; click again while equipped to unequip

slots.item: Greyed-out tag plaquette marked 'Not yet earned'

slots.action: Opens a chat prompt to search all tags by name/description, including ones you don't own yet
Page through results when more than 12 tags match
Returns to the main profile page

guis.notes: The equipped tag is marked with a gold star and 'Equipped' in its tooltip; owned-but-unequipped tags show a green checkmark and 'You have this tag'.

guis.title: Discord
guis.description: Sub-page of the player Profile menu showing your linked Discord account, boost/supporter status, and the Booster tag redeem button.
guis.how_to_open: Open /profile, then click the Discord button on the main profile page.

slots.action: Shows your linked Discord username, link date, messages sent and Discord level; click to link if not yet connected
Shows whether you are currently boosting the ReimaginedCraft Discord and for how long
Claims and equips the Booster tag while you are actively boosting; shows 'already redeemed' once claimed, or a locked hint if you aren't boosting

guis.notes: Redeeming here is the only way to obtain the Booster tag; it is not listed as unowned-but-earnable anywhere else.

entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Tags page once granted.
entries.icon_hint: a small teal name-tag plaquette with a simple code-bracket symbol on it

entries.name: Beta Tester
entries.how_to_get: Granted automatically the moment you join the network for the first time while the beta window is still open (before the beta cutoff date). No command or menu action needed — it's applied on join.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Tags page once granted.
entries.icon_hint: a small purple name-tag plaquette with a small hourglass symbol
entries.notes: Joining before the cutoff also drops a separate 'Beta Ticket' item into your backpack at the same time; that item is part of the bag system, not this tag.

entries.name: Booster
entries.how_to_get: Link your Discord account to your ReimaginedCraft profile and boost the ReimaginedCraft Discord server, then claim it via the 'Redeem Tag' button on the profile's Discord page.
entries.how_to_use: Redeeming it also equips it immediately; you can later switch to a different owned tag from the Tags page and switch back at any time while still boosting.
entries.icon_hint: a small violet name-tag plaquette with a small rocket or sparkle icon
entries.notes: The only tag designed to be temporary: it is meant to go away once you stop boosting the Discord, unlike every other tag on this list which is kept forever once earned.

open_questions: Whether the Booster tag is actually auto-revoked the moment a boost lapses (and by what mechanism/timing) could not be confirmed in the Paper-side codebase — the tag is flagged 'dynamic' and documented as being enforced 'via the Discord bridge', and the revoke path does exist and correctly un-equips the tag when called, but the code that would call it on boost expiry appears to live outside this repo (the Discord bot side).

Community-contribution tags (Bug Hunter, Idea, Fan Artist, Clipper, Translator, Friendly) have no automatic in-game tracking found in the code — they read as staff-awarded recognition tags rather than something with a visible in-game counter or command a player can check progress against.

The exact definition of 'completing' Diamond Trophy for the Trophy tag (e.g. finishing vs. winning) is not spelled out beyond the one-line description, and no automatic grant path for the Trophy or No Hit tags was found — both currently appear to be staff-awarded.
